text: The Juniper planning summary for 3–10 November lists corrected settings that supersede earlier drafts, such as quota batch_size 900 and checkout ttl_s 360. Hard rules prohibit search depending on feed, sync depending on media, and any dependency path from session to ledger or from archive to ingest. Checkout and sync, and export and feed, must not share a worker, but ingest and checkout, and shipping and upload, may. Catalog/shipping and billing/checkout run on separate workers. Required ordering is metrics before reports, feed before scheduler, quota before session, and checkout before shipping. Ownership is media on alpha, alerts, inventory, and catalog on beta, reports and profile on gamma, and metrics and ledger on delta. Feed retries are fixed at 9 and sync at 8. Pricing retries at 6 per client requirement, and if feed exceeds 6, shipping must be 1 or less. Open items include a month-end security review, a budget review moved to next Thursday, and a suggested client demo.
